items.title: Use the canonical Proof-or-Stop adapter path in the pre-review live-proof smoke
items.context: The current smoke hardcodes .lattice-codex/agents even though the identity cutover tracks .proof-or-stop-codex. Resolve through the shared brand-path contract and retain explicit legacy compatibility tests where required.

items.title: Authorize the registered acceptance-rollout verifier with least privilege
items.context: The production cohort runner assigns acceptance-rollout-verifier, then its nested review_run_start is rejected as an unknown actor. Model the exact internal verifier authority without making arbitrary unknown identities trusted; add negative coverage for lookalikes and preserve mutation command boundaries.
